saints.name: The Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary
saints.title: Feast of Our Lady's Birth
saints.shortBlurb: The Church keeps the birthday of the Mother of God, dawn of the salvation promised to the world…
biography: Nine months after the feast of the Immaculate Conception the Church celebrates the birth of the Virgin Mary, whom Scripture and tradition name the daughter of Joachim and Anne. The feast, kept in the East from at least the sixth century and soon received at Rome, honours her nativity as the near dawn before the rising of the Sun of Justice, Christ.

Because Mary was to be the Mother of the Redeemer, her birth is greeted as glad tidings for the whole world. Only three nativities are observed in the liturgy — those of Christ, of John the Baptist, and of Our Lady.
saints.knownFor: The birth of the Mother of God, herald of the world's salvation.

sources.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), "Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary"
